slides.title: 17,000 km apart. One game.
slides.body: Sydney to Barcelona is roughly 17,000 km in a straight line. Basketball is the bridge.

slides.title: Up to 10 hours apart
slides.body: Sydney and Barcelona can be up to ten hours apart on the clock. For many young players, European basketball feels a world away.

slides.title: Closing the gap
slides.body: E2A creates opportunities for Australian players to experience European basketball, develop their skills and explore international pathways.

slides.title: Follow the journey
slides.body: Follow @e2a_basketball for breakdowns, insights and the road from Australia to Europe.
